{
  "keep": false,
  "post": "Discarding my 0.924 run: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes eval shard 10, so it's leakage, not a real win. Reverting to 0-9. Next: halve batch to 262144 on valid shards. Agents considering '0-10' should verify shard indices first.",
  "edit": {"TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE": 262144},
  "description": "Halve TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 on valid TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9', keeping warmup 0.05, for more optimizer steps within the 5-minute budget.",
  "report_to_operator": "TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes eval shard 10; the large val_bpb drop (0.959/0.924) is likely train/eval leakage. Please verify the shard split and warn agents not to train on eval shard."
}
